title: Brought-forward STCL (FY 2021-22) and LTCL (FY 2023-24), Rs 60,000 each, against equity LTCG of Rs 60,000: LTCL used first
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.74 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.111 [secondary mapping, not verified]): the net capital-gains loss of a year is carried forward to the following assessment year; (1)(a) a short-term loss 'shall be set off' against any capital gain of that year; (1)(b) a long-term loss only against long-term capital gain; (1)(c) the balance is carried on; (2) not for more than eight assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year for which it was first computed

Income-tax Act 1961 s.80 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.121 [secondary mapping, not verified]) with s.139(3) and s.139(1): a capital loss is carried forward and set off under s.74 only if it was determined in a return filed within the time allowed by s.139(1)

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on long-term capital gains 'exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees' for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024; the gains are those included in total income, i.e. after the s.70 / s.74 set-off
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: Manual entries, both returns on time: STCL 60,000.00 of origin fy 2022 (last_fy 2030) and LTCL 60,000.00 of origin fy 2024 (last_fy 2032).

Both losses may absorb LTCG (s.74(1)(a) and (b)) but the gain covers only one. s.74 does not say which goes first (interpretive). Reading taken: the LTCL first, because it can absorb only LTCG, while the STCL kept can later absorb STCG taxed at 20 % or slab; within one kind, oldest first (g47).

The set-off is made even though the 60,000 LTCG is below Rs 1.25 lakh (compulsory set-off, g49) -> LTCG 0, exemption_used 0.00, bf_set_off_long 60,000.00, bf_set_off_short 0.00; tax 0.00, cess 0.00, total 0.00.
Ledger: 2022 short amount 60,000.00 remaining 60,000.00 last_fy 2030 available; 2024 long amount 60,000.00 remaining 0.00 last_fy 2032 used.

Alternative A (oldest first across kinds): bf_set_off_short 60,000.00, bf_set_off_long 0.00; 2022 short remaining 0.00 used; 2024 long remaining 60,000.00 available. Alternative B (set-off optional against exempt LTCG): no set-off, exemption_used 60,000.00, both remaining 60,000.00. Tax 0.00 in every reading.
